item.title: Editorial: American public, officials finally seem to be tiring of Trump’s racist postings
item.description: President Donald Trump on Friday drew widespread outrage for a post made to his Truth Social media account Thursday night. It depicted former President Barack Obama and first lady Michelle Obama as apes. Administration staffers were quick to defend the president, with spokeswoman Karoline Leavitt calling it “fake outrage” — a common way they try to downplay the many criticisms their boss draws.
